text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kaiser Insight was targeted by the guild Rage Legion and sent to a prison deep underground for protection. There, he was visited by Queen Labyrinth, Labyrista, a fellow member of the Seven Crowns.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【レイジ・レギオン】に身柄を狙われ、
地中深くの牢獄に移送された覇瞳皇帝を、
同じ七冠である迷宮女王、ラビリスタが訪ねてきた。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: 'Sup. Mana, doing well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんちゃーっす。
真那、
元気でやってる？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Disappear. I don't want to be shown the face of the second person I want to murder the most.
text_block_list.orig_text:
消えなさい。
この世で二番目に殺意を覚える顔を見せないで。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Could it bother you to answer my question with an answer? Also, I wasn't aware I got demoted from the first spot. No wait, maybe me and the boy are rounded together, so it's a packaged deal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
質問には
答えで返してくれないかな？
それと、
一番目から降格したとは知らなかったよ。
いや、
アタシと少年は一蓮托生だから、
ワンツーフィニッシュ？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Do you really love to invest your free time into annoying people like this? ...How uncouth. It seems like those lowlives have done a number on you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうやって
人の神経を逆撫でしに来る暇があるのかしら？
……無様ね。
下っ端にいいようにやられたみたいじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Ah, so you could tell? That's right, and seriously, who even were those guys? Ah, sorry, Mana it's not like you'd know, huh...? Even you are new to this whole "loop" we're experiencing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
分かる？　
そうなんだよ、
マジでアイツら何者？
っと
ごめん、
真那は知らないか……
『この周回』は、
アンタでさえ初めてだもんね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You're a fool, so it is no surprise you can't even grasp what's going on. I almost feel sorry for you, being unable to predict such a situation with your paltry skills...
text_block_list.orig_text:
愚鈍なあなたには察しもつかないでしょうね。
その程度の事態も予測できないなんて、
かわいそうに……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: What's that～?! I'll have you know I did EVERYTHING to protect you from those enemies, even though I didn't really feel like it! You should be grateful that you're not currently their prisoner!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何を～！？　
アンタを敵から守るために、
本っ当～
に不本意ながら色々頑張ったんですけど！？
利用されずに済んでるだけありがたいと思え！

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Prisoner I still am, what would I be grateful for. It's hilarious that someone called "Queen Labyrinth" can't even solve other people's labyrinths.
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰が感謝なんてするものですか。
迷宮女王が
他人の迷宮は解けないなんて笑えるわ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If you don't improve your attitude right now, there won't be a second time. Do you understand?
text_block_list.orig_text:
態度の改善が見られないと二度目はないよ。
いいんだね
それで？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Even if you were to abandon me to such a fate, there's always a certain someone you want to learn more about out there, so the chances of that happening are close to zero.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたが見捨てたくても、
どうせ誰かさんがいるから、
その結果に至る確率は限りなくゼロに近いわ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: How groaning... If you could see through that much and also know how things would turn out... I wish you'd reflect on your actions already. Things are getting hectic outside, so I want you to cooperate like we used to...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうところまで見透かしてるならこうなるか……
もうそろそろ反省しててほしかったんだけどな。
色々大変だから、
昔みたいに協力してほしいし……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You already know the answer, don't you? Even Chris and Neneka understood quicker than you did.
text_block_list.orig_text:
答えなら
分かっているんでしょう？
クリスやネネカは
あなたより物分かりがよかったわよ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, I see. I suppose you truly cannot be persuaded after all... Then I'll ask someone else to take my place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっそ。
やっぱアタシじゃ説得は無理か……
じゃあ
代わりの人、
お願いしまーす。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...Akira. You know it'll have the opposite effect, but you're still doing it, aren't you? You're the same as me. A truly inedible woman...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
晶。
逆効果だと分かっていて仕掛けてるわね？
やっぱりあなたも私と同類だわ。
本当に食えない女……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I'm the kind of woman who drags you in. Well then, you two can relax together. See you later, boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシは一杯食わせる女だからね。
そんじゃ、
後はお二人でごゆっくり～。
また後でね、
少年。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...What are you here for, coming to visit me when I'm in a terrible mood?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
最悪な気分のところに押しかけてきて、
何がしたいのかしら、
あなたは？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...That girl is as foolish as ever. What a shame, the world hasn't been destroyed just yet. Oh? You... you're a little different than before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの子も変わらず愚かなのね。
それに残念だわ。
まだ世界が滅んでないなんて。
あら？　
あなた……
前とは少し違うわね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I can definitely feel a sense of fulfillment in you, but behind that... Impatience, agitation, anxiety... Are you scared?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何かを得た充実感の裏に、
確かに感じるわ。
焦り、
動揺、
不安……
怯えているのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Heheh, heheheh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
ふふふっ……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Yet even in that state, you're still going out there trying to fight for someone else... It makes me want to vomit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな状態でまだ、
誰かのために戦おうとしているのね……
反吐が出るわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Serves you right♪ You look so scared deep down, knowing what awaits you beyond that turning point...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ざまあみなさい♪
転換点の先に待っていたものを知って、
心の底では恐れを抱いている顔だわ……！

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You're really stupid. Just because you defeated me, you think you can win against that thing...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に馬鹿ね。
私を倒したからといって、
あなたたちがアレに勝てるとでも……
？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: No, that's not even it. She still hasn't shown herself just yet...? That's right. Since you're still safe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
違うわね。
まだ姿すら見せていない……？
そうね。
あなたが無事なのだものね……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Well, nevermind. Your next enemy is one you're going to find troublesome, for many different reasons. There's no point in struggling. Just give up and take it easy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいいわ。
今度のあなたの敵は厄介よ。
あがくだけ無駄ね。
諦めて楽になりなさい。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Hehe, such a question really pisses me off. You've tried to make things easier for yourself many times, so surely you can at least understand how I feel?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
今のはカチンとくる問いかけだったわ。
あなただって
何度も楽になろうとした身だし、
私の気持ちくらい分かるんじゃないかしら？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That's fine. You still don't understand how it feels like everything you've done ends up being wasted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そう。
ならいいわ。
全てが無駄になった気分なんて、
今のあなたにはまだ分からないのね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: It's strange that nobody's trying to teach you such a lesson... I suppose they're trying to be considerate of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰も吹き込もうとしないのも変だけど……
あなたか、
別の誰かに配慮でもしてるつもりなのね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I'll have a special seat at the table to enjoy your pathetic struggle against her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつに対しての惨めなあがきを、
特等席で楽しませてもらうわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: And from that result, even if it means I have to fight over and over I'll...
text_block_list.orig_text:
その結果、
私がまた繰り返し
抗うことになるとしても……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...You've already heard why during our battle.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……あの戦いであなたが聞いたことが全てよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: The other world couldn’t save me. I wanted to obtain the world that I wished for.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あちらの世界は、
私を救えなかった。
私の望む、
願いのままの世界を手に入れたかった。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: With my soul still trapped in a human body, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒトの身に魂を囚われたままでは、
私は……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You think that by knowing that it'd be easier to sympathize with me? Hehehe, I guess I'm being looked down upon right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
同情しやすくなったとでも？
ふふふっ、
私も安く見られたものね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I intended to reign over the world as a perfect God. That was the plan, but an unexpected interruption occurred...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
完全な神として君臨するつもりだった。
そのはずだったのに、
思わぬ邪魔が入ったわ……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Akira, you and the rest of your friends. If you'd just behaved in your place, you would've gotten out of this unscathed, but you decided to do unnecessary things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
晶とあなたたちよ。
大人しくしていれば無事で済んだのに、
余計なことばかりしてくれたわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, my plan went haywire, and now this current world is the result of all that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげで
私の計画は狂いに狂って、
その結果がこれよ……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: The magic lamp has broken, and the genie inside has gone mad...
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法のランプは壊れてしまって、
中の魔神も
まともじゃなくなった……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: The beings that rule this world would decapitate me, or anyone else for that matter, even if we were to tell them a bedtime story.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この世界を支配している存在には、
たとえ本当に千夜と一夜
物語を語り聞かせても首をはねられる。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I am able to kill everyone, except for one person, you... Such an hard truth was hard for me to accept.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ一人、
あなた以外は……
認めがたい事実だったわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Of course. Think about it. No matter who else happens to die in this world, it won't rewind itself. That's true for myself, Akira, or anyone else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
当然じゃない。
考えてみなさい。
あなた以外の誰が死んでも、
この世界は巻き戻らない。
私も、
晶も、
他の誰だってみんな同じ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: When you were resurrected during that battle, I thought I finally understood everything, but I suppose I was wrong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの戦いの最中によみがえった時、
理解したと思ったのだけど、
違ったのね……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I don’t know if the reason they're after us Seven Crowns and the reason they're fighting you are the same.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつが私たち七冠を狙う理由と、
あなたが戦う理由が同じかは知らないわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: The only enemy I know... is you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の知っている敵の目的は
あなたよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. No, that's not true. There's also another person. That girl...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
違ったわね。
もう一人いたわ。
あの子は……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Now, who was it...? It's been so long since I was trapped here that I've forgotten her face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあて、
誰だったかしら……？
ここに囚われてから長くて
もう忘れてしまったわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...Don't ask me things you can figure out with a little thought yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……少し考えれば分かることを
私に聞かないでちょうだい。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: That impulsive judgement of yours is such a nuisance... It's been that way ever since we first met.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その直情的な判断がどれだけ迷惑だったか……
初めて会った時からずっとそうだったわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Also, please show me more skepticism that my words might be lies. I want to see more of your confusion and suffering.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
私の言葉が嘘かもしれないと、
もっと疑いなさい。
そうして
迷い苦しむところをもっと見せなさい。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Who knows...? Either way, it doesn't matter to me right now. I have no interest in your future. There's no point in worrying about what I can't get my hands on...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ……？　
今の私にはどちらでもいいわ。
あなたたちの未来に私は興味がないの。
自分が手にできないものを気にしても意味がないもの……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...Regardless of what happened in the past, I lost and you won. As a loser, I will take responsibility for my actions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……過去はどうあれ、
私は負けて
あなたたちは勝った。
敗者として
自分の行いに対する責任はとるわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I won't add having to get along with that cheeky woman with the red glasses as part of those responsibilities, but I think those pointless chats with you are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたとの無駄話もその一つとして、
あの生意気赤メガネが勘定するのかは知らないけど。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You should be careful not to wear yourself down after being worked up. ...If you're getting even me worried about your condition, you should know it's bad, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こき使われて摩耗しないよう
あなたも気をつけなさい。
……私に心配されているようだと、
先は暗いわよ？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: That child never learns her lesson, does she... Has she decided to keep up this stupid theatre forever? I won't eat them, so they'll just get thrown out or rot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
懲りないわね、
あの子……
相変わらず馬鹿なの？
私は食べないから、
捨てられるか
腐敗するだけよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Take those things and go home. I've lost my motivation to talk.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを持って帰りなさい。
話す気が失せたわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder when you'll decide to grant my wish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いつになったら
私の願いを叶えてくれるかしらね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...There's no need for the boy to feel murderous towards you, is there?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……少年がその気になることはないんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Eavesdropping, now? It seems your shallow personality is truly on full force today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
盗み聞き？　
相変わらず趣味が悪いわね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Mana. If you wanted to become a god, you shouldn't have done anything to anyone. Most of the actions of gods are just a nuisance to humans.
text_block_list.orig_text:
真那。
アンタが神になろうとしたのなら、
誰に対しても、
何もしてやるべきじゃなかったんだよ。
神様の行動なんて、
人間にとっては大体が迷惑なんだからさ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: No counseling from you. Get out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カウンセラーはお断りよ。
出ていきなさい。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm leaving. ...Besides, I think the boy wants to show you what lies beyond all those Bad Ends. He might want to take responsibility for defeating you, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーケイ、
出ていくとも。
……それに少年は、
アンタに示したいんじゃないかな。
バッドエンドのその先をさ。
倒した責任をとりたいのは、
彼も同じかもしれないよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...No one asked him to do that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……誰も頼んでないわよ、
そんなの。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Hearing Kaiser Insight's mutterings, Labyrista left the prison with a bitter smile at the attitude of her former comrade.
text_block_list.orig_text:
覇瞳皇帝のつぶやきを耳にしたラビリスタは、
かつての仲間の態度に苦笑しながら、
牢獄を後にするのだった。
